title: TLS certificate expiry causing ingress failures
symptoms: Browser/clients report ERR_CERT_DATE_INVALID or SSL handshake failures
Ingress returns 502/503 with TLS errors in controller logs
Datadog synthetic test failures on HTTPS endpoints
root_cause: Certificate not managed by cert-manager; manual renewal missed or cert-manager ClusterIssuer misconfigured
workaround: Manually renew cert via cert-manager Certificate resource or import renewed cert to ACM/secret; restart ingress controller if needed
permanent_fix: Migrate all ingress TLS to cert-manager with automated Let's Encrypt or internal CA; add 30/14/7-day pre-expiry Datadog monitors on cert expiry metrics

auto_healing.mechanism: cert-manager auto-renews at 2/3 lifetime; ESO syncs renewed secret to ingress

notes: Inventory all non-cert-manager TLS certs during remediation Phase 1
